title: ברכיה בר חלבו
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Berekhiah bar Chelbo, in the name of Rava bar Zavda (see above, Rabbi Abba bar Zavda). Perhaps it is a scribal error and should read “Rabbi Berekhiah and Rabbi Chelbo,” for they are mentioned together in many places.
